vision.text:
(If this card is revealed from your hand, gain 3 stages.)

Focused. Unpreventable. Raise your anger 2. Your opponent can only attack or pass in their next action this combat.

HIT: You may lower your MP 1 level to draw a card.
(Banish after use.)
